title: Shaggy's Brazilian Bake
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Brazilian-inspired bake with a twist of sweet and spicy flavors.

ingredients.name: Light brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality brown sugar for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Brazilian shaggy pastry dough
ingredients.notes: Follow package instructions for thawing and rising

ingredients.name: Shaggy's special spice blend
ingredients.notes: Mix equal parts cinnamon, nutmeg, and cayenne pepper for a unique flavor

ingredients.name: Shaggy's secret ingredient
ingredients.notes: A sweet and spicy chocolate spread for an extra kick

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.notes: Room temperature eggs for better mixing

ingredients.name: Bake vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: High-quality vanilla extract for the best flavor

instructions: Thaw and rise the pastry dough according to package instructions.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract. Mix until smooth and creamy.
Add the Shaggy's special spice blend and mix until well combined.
Add the chocolate spread and mix until a smooth, thick batter forms.
Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Spread the batter evenly over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling to create a crust.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
